title: Senior Frontend Developer (React / TypeScript)
text:
We are seeking a passionate Senior Frontend Developer to lead our client-facing web application development. 

Key Responsibilities:
- Build scalable, responsive web applications using React, TypeScript, and modern CSS3.
- Architect state management solutions using Redux and optimize web performance.
- Collaborate in an Agile / Scrum environment with designers, product managers, and backend engineers.
- Champion Accessibility (a11y) standards and clean code practices.

Required Qualifications:
- 4+ years of professional software development experience.
- Strong proficiency in JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, and HTML5.
- Hands-on experience with React, REST API integration, and Git.
- Deep understanding of Responsive Web Design and cross-browser compatibility.
- Excellent Problem Solving and Communication skills.

Preferred / Nice-to-Have:
- Experience with Next.js and Tailwind CSS is a plus.
- Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, Docker, and Webpack.
- Knowledge of Automated testing using Jest or Cypress is preferred.
- Exposure to AWS cloud infrastructure.

title: Full Stack Engineer (Node.js & React)
text:
CloudPulse Systems is hiring a Full Stack Engineer to build high-performance microservices and intuitive user interfaces.

Responsibilities:
- Design and implement REST APIs and Microservices using Node.js and Express.js.
- Develop modern frontend interfaces using React, HTML, and CSS.
- Work with relational databases like PostgreSQL (SQL) and NoSQL stores like MongoDB.
- Write clean, maintainable code following TDD and OOP principles.

Must-Have Skills:
- Required 3+ years experience with JavaScript, Node.js, and Express.
- Strong expertise in SQL databases, RESTful web services, and Git version control.
- Proficiency in Teamwork, Adaptability, and Critical Thinking.

Bonus Points:
- Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and AWS cloud services is a major plus.
- Knowledge of GraphQL and Redis is nice to have.
- Background in System Design and CI/CD automated deployments.

title: Backend Software Engineer (Java / Python / Cloud)
text:
Join FinData Enterprise as a Backend Engineer focused on real-time data streaming and distributed backend systems.

Requirements:
- Must have 3+ years writing enterprise code in Java or Python.
- Essential knowledge of SQL databases, Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), and Data Structures.
- Proven track record designing REST API architecture and System Design.
- Required experience with Git, Docker, and Linux Shell / Bash scripts.
- Excellent verbal and written Communication skills.

Nice to Have:
- Preferred experience with Spring Boot, C++, or Go.
- Familiarity with Microservices, AWS cloud Services, and Kubernetes is desired.
- Understanding of Agile methodologies and CI/CD pipelines is a plus.

title: Junior Web Developer / Graduate Switcher
text:
BrightSpark Digital is looking for an enthusiastic Junior Web Developer to join our growing agency team.

Role Overview:
- Build interactive, mobile-friendly websites using HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript.
- Work with UI/UX designers to translate Figma designs into pixel-perfect code.
- Assist with website maintenance, SEO optimization, and bug fixing.

Core Requirements:
- Solid understanding of core web fundamentals: HTML, CSS, JavaScript (ES6).
- Familiarity with Git for code management.
- Strong Problem Solving, Teamwork, and eagerness for Mentoring and learning.

Nice to Have:
- Basic experience with React or Vue.js is a plus.
- Exposure to Tailwind CSS or Sass is preferred.
- Understanding of Web Performance basics.
